dxf.annotation_scope: Floor plans with dimension chains (true DIMENSION entities), tags, grid, levels and section marker; elevations, section and schedules are in PDF/SVG.

ifc.exterior_scope: Facade and landscape assemblies are represented in scene/GLB and drawings; IFC includes wall/opening/space coordination and movable furniture meshes.
ifc.scope: Walls, spaces, floor/roof slabs, related apertures, storeys; authored movable furniture meshes when a scene is supplied. No reinforcement or certified MEP.
